# @rxova/react-measurement-input

> A headless, accessible measurement field for React: `5 ft 11 in`,
> `12 st 2 lb`, `1 m 80 cm` as real spinbuttons, with unit words from `Intl` and
> exact conversion built in. The value is always an `"<amount> <unit>"` string —
> `71 inch` — where the unit half is an `Intl` unit identifier, never a bare
> number. Zero runtime dependencies. No stylesheet to import.

## Install

    npm install @rxova/react-measurement-input

`react >= 18` is the only peer dependency.

## Minimal working example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react'
import { MeasurementInput } from '@rxova/react-measurement-input'

export function Profile() {
  const [height, setHeight] = useState<string | null>(null)

  return (
    <MeasurementInput
      label="Height"
      units={['foot', 'inch']}
      value={height}
      onChange={setHeight}
      max="2.2 meter"
    />
  )
}
```

Any units of one dimension whose adjacent pairs divide exactly, largest first:

```tsx
import { MeasurementInput } from '@rxova/react-measurement-input'

export function Examples() {
  return (
    <>
      <MeasurementInput label="Weight" units={['stone', 'pound']} />
      <MeasurementInput label="Parcel" units={['kilogram', 'gram']} />
      <MeasurementInput label="Fever" units={['celsius']} precision={1} />
    </>
  )
}
```

## Props

`<MeasurementInput>` — the full surface is `MeasurementInputProps` in the published types.

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `string \| null` | — | Controlled `"<amount> <unit>"`, e.g. `71 inch`, or `null` for empty. |
| `defaultValue` | `string \| null` | — | Uncontrolled initial value. Ignored when `value` is set. |
| `onChange` | `(value: string \| null) => void` | — | Fires on complete, and when that stops. Never mid-entry. |
| `onPartsChange` | `(parts: MeasurementParts) => void` | — | Every keystroke, including while incomplete. |
| `min` | `string` | — | Smallest allowed measurement, inclusive. May be in any unit of the dimension. |
| `max` | `string` | — | Largest allowed measurement, inclusive. May be in any unit of the dimension. |
| `emitOutOfRange` | `boolean` | `true` | Reports an out-of-range measurement and marks the field invalid, rather than discarding it. |
| `units` | `MeasurementUnit[]` | `['meter', 'centimeter']` | Which units to edit. Sorted largest-first, deduped, one dimension, adjacent pairs must divide exactly. |
| `precision` | `number` | `0` | Decimal places on the smallest segment only, 0 to 6. |
| `step` | `number` | one unit of `precision` | Arrow-key step for the smallest segment. Every other segment steps by one. |
| `locale` | `string` | the runtime's locale | BCP 47 tag deciding the unit suffixes and segment names. Presentation only. |
| `placeholders` | `MeasurementPlaceholders` | dashes, one per digit | Per-unit placeholder text. |
| `unitLabels` | `MeasurementUnitLabels` | the locale's own words | Per-unit accessible name. |
| `renderSegment` | `(state: MeasurementSegmentState) => ReactNode` | — | Custom rendering for one segment. |
| `label` | `ReactNode` | — | Accessible name for the whole field. |
| `className` | `string` | — | |
| `style` | `CSSProperties` | — | |
| `name` | `string` | — | Emits a hidden input carrying `"<amount> <unit>"`, readable by a native `<form>`. |
| `required` | `boolean` | `false` | Surfaced as `aria-required` on the group. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | |
| `readOnly` | `boolean` | `false` | |
| `dir` | `'ltr' \| 'rtl'` | inherited | Lays the field out; unit order is always largest-first. |
| `invalid` | `boolean` | `false` | Sets `aria-invalid` and `data-invalid`. |
| `aria-describedby` | `string` | — | ids of external error/help text. |
| `id` | `string` | — | Base id; segments derive `${id}-foot`, `${id}-inch`, … |
| `onBlur` | `(event: FocusEvent<HTMLElement>) => void` | — | Fires when focus leaves the field, never between segments. |
| `onFocus` | `(event: FocusEvent<HTMLElement>) => void` | — | |
| `onWarn` | `(warning: MeasurementWarning) => void` | `console.warn` | Development-only notice that a prop was coerced. Stripped from production builds. |

Also exported: the `useMeasurementInput` hook, the layout helper
`measurementPieces`, and the pure functions `convert`, `toBaseUnit`,
`dimensionOf`, `ratioBetween`, `isCarryPair`, `isMeasurementUnit`,
`parseMeasurement`, `formatMeasurement`, `toMeasurement`, `fromMeasurement`,
`compareMeasurements` and `withinMeasurementRange`, plus the
`MEASUREMENT_UNITS` list and `DEFAULT_MEASUREMENT_UNITS`.

## Styling

There is no stylesheet. Set CSS custom properties on any ancestor:
`--rx-measurement-gap`, `--rx-measurement-segment-padding`,
`--rx-measurement-segment-radius`, `--rx-measurement-suffix-opacity`,
`--rx-measurement-suffix-size`, `--rx-measurement-focus-ring`,
`--rx-measurement-focus-ring-offset`.

The focused segment paints a ring by default (`2px solid Highlight`), because a
`<span role="spinbutton">` gets none from the browser. Restyle it through those
two properties rather than removing it.

Or target the `data-*` attributes, which are public API covered by semver:
`data-rx-measurement-root`, `data-rx-measurement-dimension`
(`length` / `mass` / `volume` / `area` / `digital` / `temperature`),
`data-rx-measurement-segment` (the unit identifier),
`data-rx-measurement-value`, `data-rx-measurement-leading` (the unbounded
segment) and `data-rx-measurement-trailing` (the one that may carry decimals),
plus the shared state hooks `data-complete`, `data-out-of-range`,
`data-placeholder`, `data-focused`, `data-disabled`, `data-readonly`,
`data-invalid`.

## Four mistakes to avoid

1. **Comparing two values with `===` or `<`.** The value is emitted in the
   smallest unit on screen, so `'71 inch'` and `'1.8034 meter'` are the same
   height and different strings. Use `compareMeasurements` or `toBaseUnit`;
   `min` and `max` already do.
2. **Passing a bare number as `value`.** The prop is `"<amount> <unit>"`. A
   number needs a units contract travelling beside it, and removing that
   contract is what this component is for.
3. **Pairing units that do not divide.** `units={['meter', 'inch']}` is refused
   with a `units-ratio-not-integer` warning: a metre is 39.37 inches, so the
   inches segment would have no ceiling to carry at. `['foot', 'inch']` works
   because a foot is exactly twelve.
4. **Reaching for a time unit.** `day`, `hour`, `minute` and the rest are `Intl`
   units and are refused here with a `units-not-convertible` warning. Durations
   are a different value with a different canonical form — use
   `@rxova/react-duration-input`.
